pr_title: rails console: Handle non standard application names
pr_body:
Fix: https://github.com/rails/rails/issues/52615
Ref: https://github.com/rails/rails/pull/50796

The code assumed the application follow the standard `Name::Application` naming, but it's possible to rename it however you like.
pr_comments: That was fast, thank you very much.

issue_context.title: Regression: Cannot use Rails console if Rails application class is not in a module
issue_context.body:
We have 30 or so Rails applications that do not use with `SomeThing::Application` as the Rails application class. They simply declare a top level class such as `SomeThingApplication`. This was fine until Rails 7.2 where https://github.com/rails/rails/pull/50796 causes the console to fail to start.

### Steps to reproduce
Create a new rails app. Change the application class in `config/application.rb` to MyApplication without a module wrapping it.

```sh
bundle exec rails c
```

It should open a console
